original_tests.scope: Isolated original core files and six original test files; no broker/platform watcher. Repeated seven stack tests counted once; top-level functions counted, subtests not inflated.

findings: Same path with IDs1then2 retains both IDentries; DeleteById(1) removes path mapping belonging toID2 while ID2still exists. No actual filesystem operations.

Mutating stored FSInfo.Path old->new before Set leaves old alias; after DeleteById both IDmap empty and old path still resolves stale pointer. No caller immutability contract inferred before broker review.
EventStack List slice copy shares event objects: mutating returned event Path changes later Pop. Serial control, not a demonstrated concurrent race.

source_only_findings: IterateIds/Paths execute callback while RLock held; reentrant writes may block, not executed here.
Original map concurrency tests use unique IDs and unique paths; no same-path replacement or stored-object mutation coverage.
Combined fsnotify operations map to first matching operation by fixed priority; upstream tests explicitly expect this behavior. No event-loss assertion without broker lifecycle review.
